dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons
evidence_slice: Historic England NHLE List Entry 1495589 identifies Exeter Central Station, Grade II, first listed 24 July 2026, with summary and details explicitly describing a railway station building with attached shops and offices and a footbridge. Historic England Open Data Hub FeatureServer layer 3 is 'Listed Building polygons', geometry type esriGeometryPolygon, and exposes ListEntry, Name and Grade fields; Historic England's current Open Data Hub terms state that all newly listed buildings since 4 April 2011 contain a map showing a blue line around the principal listed building. The exact ListEntry=1495589 GeoJSON query returned no readable payload in the available web channel, and a separate direct network attempt failed during DNS resolution before any feature geometry was received.
